item.description:
Beta release — thanks for testing.

Fixes

  • Fixed a crash when opening Settings on macOS 27.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

New

  • Open Apple Music from the menu bar icon. Turn it on in Settings → Menu Bar. The first time, it opens with just the controls; use the sidebar button to show the music. It remembers how you left it, including whether you had it in its own window.

Improvements

  • The Apple Music sidebar button now has a small music note, so it's easier to tell what it does.
  • The ⌘1–⌘9 room numbers (hold ⌘ in the room menu) are easier to see in light mode.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

New

  • Volume keys. Press − and + (or =) to turn the selected room down or up. They don't get in the way while you're typing in a search box.
  • Quick mute. Click the small speaker icon on the left of a volume slider to turn the volume all the way down.

Improvements

  • Apple Music panel: the sidebar button now sits in the corner and moves with the panel as it opens, the mini player button is in the top bar, and everything lines up more neatly.
  • New, cleaner tooltips.
  • Click anywhere outside the search box to stop typing in it.
  • HomePods paired with an Apple TV: until the app knows their volume, the slider is dimmed and − and + step the volume from where it really is, instead of jumping.

Fixes

  • The "playing" bars no longer bounce around when you open Apple Music in its own window.
  • The volume slider no longer snaps back for a moment right after you change it.
